description: Receives messages from a Google Cloud Pub/Sub pull subscription. Polls with the unary Pull API, acknowledges each message before publishing it, and pulls again immediately while messages keep arriving.

outputs.name: Message
outputs.description: Decoded data of the last acknowledged message. Stays unchanged when a pull returns nothing. The same text can arrive twice; seq increases on every delivery.

outputs.name: Sequence
outputs.description: Number of messages acknowledged and delivered. Starts at 0 and increases by one for every message, including a repeat of the same text.

outputs.name: Status
outputs.description: HTTP status code of the last completed token, pull or acknowledge request. 0 means no request has finished yet.

outputs.name: Success
outputs.description: True if the last completed request returned HTTP 200.

config.name: Service account key
config.description: Full JSON content of the GCP service account key file used for authentication.

config.name: Subscription
config.description: Name of the pull subscription to receive messages from.

config.name: Poll interval
config.description: Seconds to wait after an empty pull or an error before asking again. After a message is delivered the next pull starts at once.

state.name: Token expiry
state.description: Uptime in milliseconds when the cached token expires.

state.name: Phase
state.description: Async operation tracker: 0 = idle, 1 = awaiting token, 2 = awaiting pull response, 3 = awaiting acknowledge response.

state.name: Phase started
state.description: Uptime in milliseconds when the current HTTP request started. A request stuck for more than 10 seconds is abandoned.

state.name: Pending ack ID
state.description: Acknowledgement id of the message being confirmed. Cleared once the acknowledge call finishes.

state.name: Pending message
state.description: Decoded message held until the acknowledge call succeeds. Only then is it written to the message output.

state.name: Last poll
state.description: Timestamp of the last scheduled poll in seconds since epoch.

state.name: Next poll
state.description: Timestamp of the next scheduled poll in seconds since epoch.
